reference.zone: les deux figures de droite (face, trois-quarts)

planche.prompt: The Sewn One, a huge, wide and lopsided brute assembled from several bodies joined by crude thick pale stitches across bloated pale flesh, with a smaller extra torso and limp arms sewn onto its chest. Long matted hair and a crown of rusted iron spikes on the head. The entire right forearm is replaced by a massive rusted iron hammer-arm ending in a heavy forged block, bound with leather straps and rivets. A torn loincloth of rags with hanging chains and a rusted round pendant, cloth-wrapped feet. Wide, asymmetric silhouette; the stitches read clearly.

source.prompt: A huge heavy figure standing in place, slowly rocking its weight from one leg to the other, heavy arms hanging loose, looping smoothly.
